summary: ansible-inventory -i test.yml --list shows hostvars per device and the group tree to verify a network inventory.
questions: How do I verify my network inventory is correct?
How can I see the variables each host gets?

answer_card.title: Verify a network inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
ansible-inventory -i test.yml --list
```
Output shows `_meta.hostvars` (each host's `ansible_connection`, `ansible_host`, `ansible_network_os`, `ansible_user`) and the group tree (`all` → `datacenter` → `network` → `leafs`/`spines`).
